text: Hackers are now cooking supermarket freezers.
Do you know what happens when someone hacks the fridge... at your grocery store?
A freezer is supposed to sit at minus eighteen degrees.
These hit fifty.
That's a hundred and twenty-two Fahrenheit.
Nobody broke in. Nobody cut the power.
Hackers just logged into the cooling controls online...
and turned up the heat.
In France, around seven hundred food sites got hit in one weekend.
Meat, ice cream, milk... all thrown away. And at least fifteen fires.
Then, three weeks later...
it happened again. Nine countries. Over a hundred stores. Overnight.
One store manager said, everything is destroyed.
So what happens next?
Germany's cyber agency says lots of cooling systems are still wide open.
And it's not just supermarkets. Warehouses. Medicine storage. Delivery trucks.
So the next big hack might not steal your password...
it might melt your groceries.
Would you still trust the frozen aisle?
Comment yes or no.
